articles.title_en: Violence against women and the substitution of help services in times of lockdown: Triangulation of three data sources in Germany
articles.title_cn: 封锁期间针对妇女的暴力行为和帮助服务的替代：德国三个数据源的三角测量
articles.abstract_en: We study the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on domestic violence against women in Germany in 2020. The analysis draws on three data sources: (1) longitudinal administrative data on the volume of help requests to helplines, shelters and counselling services, (2) cross-sectional survey data collected during the first wave of the pandemic, and (3) a qualitative online survey with counsellors and domestic violence experts. The number of violence-related requests at helplines increased significantly by 34% with the first physical distancing measures, whereas ambulatory care services such as shelters experienced a 14% increase in help requests only after physical distancing restrictions were lifted. Our results indicate that individuals substituted help services away from ambulatory care towards helplines. We do not observe exacerbated violence in states with greater mobility reductions, lower day care capacity for childcare or higher COVID-19 infection numbers. Yet, our cross-sectional household-level data suggests that home quarantine and financial distress may have been triggers of violence. Our findings highlight the importance of providing easily accessible online counselling offers for survivors of violence and governmental financial relief packages.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在2020研究了新冠肺炎19大流行对德国针对妇女的家庭暴力的影响。该分析利用了三个数据源：(1) 关于求助热线、庇护所和咨询服务的帮助请求量的纵向行政数据，(2) 在第一波大流行期间收集的横断面调查数据，以及 (3) 咨询师和家庭暴力专家的定性在线调查。首次采取保持社交距离措施后，求助热线收到的与暴力相关的请求数量显着增加了 34%，而只有在解除保持社交距离限制后，庇护所等流动护理服务机构的帮助请求数量才出现了 14% 增加。我们的结果表明，个人将帮助服务从门诊护理转向求助热线。我们没有观察到在流动性减少幅度较大、儿童日托能力较低或 COVID-19 感染人数较多的州，暴力行为加剧。然而，我们的家庭横截面数据表明，家庭隔离和经济困难可能是暴力的触发因素。我们的研究结果强调了为暴力幸存者提供易于获取的在线咨询服务和政府财政救助计划的重要性。

articles.title_en: Rational vs. irrational beliefs in a complex world
articles.title_cn: 复杂世界中的理性与非理性信念
articles.abstract_en: How do rational and boundedly rational agents interact in a competitive asset market? To answer this question, we build a highly nonlinear asset pricing model where agents hold heterogeneous beliefs. Our model features fully rational forward looking agents versus boundedly rational backward looking agents whose market shares evolve endogenously. This gives rise to chaotic model dynamics which are characterized by complex bubble and crash dynamics, even without any exogenous fluctuations. We show that computational methods can be applied to numerically analyze models combining agents forming rational expectations and agents forming extrapolative expectations, with the possibility of transition between one type of behavior and the other. Not only do we find that boundedly rational agents remain in the market, but document that their effect on price dynamics is even amplified by the behavior of fully rational agents. In their interaction, trend-extrapolators amplify small deviations from fundamentals, while rational agents eventually anticipate market crashes after large bubbles and drive prices back to the fundamental.
articles.abstract_cn: 在竞争性资产市场中，理性与有限理性代理人如何互动？为回答此问题，我们构建了一个高度非线性的资产定价模型，其中代理人持有异质信念。我们的模型包含完全理性的前瞻性代理人与有限理性的后顾性代理人，其市场份额内生演化。这导致了混沌模型动态，其特征是复杂的泡沫与崩盘动态，即使没有外生波动。我们表明，计算方法可应用于数值分析结合理性预期与外推预期的代理人模型，并考虑两种行为类型之间转换的可能性。我们不仅发现有限理性代理人留在市场中，而且记录到他们对价格动态的影响甚至被完全理性代理人的行为放大。在互动中，趋势外推者放大对基本面的微小偏离，而理性代理人最终在大泡沫后预期市场崩盘，并将价格推回基本面。

articles.title_en: Modeling adaptive forward-looking behavior in epidemics on networks
articles.title_cn: 网络流行病中适应性前瞻行为的建模
articles.abstract_en: Incorporating decision-making dynamics during an outbreak poses a challenge for epidemiology, faced by several modeling approaches siloed by different disciplines. We propose an epi-economic model where high-frequency choices of individuals respond to the infection dynamics over heterogeneous networks. Maintaining a rational forward-looking component to individual choices, agents follow a behavioral rule-of-thumb in the face of limited perceived forecasting precision in a highly uncertain epidemic environment. We describe the resulting equilibrium behavior of the epidemic by analytical expressions depending on the epidemic conditions. We study existence and welfare of equilibrium, identifying a fundamental negative externality. We also sign analytically the effects of the behavioral rule-of-thumb at different phases of the epidemic and characterize some comparative statics. Through numerical simulations, we contrast different information structures: global awareness – where individuals only know the prevalence of the disease in the population – with local awareness, where individuals know the prevalence in their neighborhood. We show that agents’ behavioral response through forward-looking choice can flatten the epidemic curve, but local awareness, by triggering highly heterogeneous behavioral responses, more effectively curbs the disease compared to global awareness.
articles.abstract_cn: 在疫情爆发期间纳入决策动态对流行病学构成了挑战，多种建模方法因学科不同而各自为政。我们提出一个流行病-经济模型，其中个体的高频选择响应于异质网络上的感染动态。在保持个体选择的理性前瞻成分的同时，代理人在高度不确定的疫情环境中，面对有限的感知预测精度，遵循行为经验法则。我们通过依赖于疫情条件的解析表达式描述了疫情导致的均衡行为。我们研究了均衡的存在性和福利，识别出一种基本的负外部性。我们还解析地指出了行为经验法则在疫情不同阶段的影响，并刻画了一些比较静态特征。通过数值模拟，我们对比了不同的信息结构：全局意识——个体仅知道人群中疾病的流行率——与局部意识——个体知道其邻域中的流行率。我们表明，代理人通过前瞻性选择的行为响应可以拉平疫情曲线，但局部意识通过触发高度异质的行为响应，比全局意识更有效地遏制疾病。

articles.title_en: The optimal choice of scaling in economic agent-based models
articles.title_cn: 基于经济主体的模型中缩放的最优选择
articles.abstract_en: In economics, two strategies are typically employed to reduce the size and complexity of models: (i) using representative agents by aggregating the actual entities, (ii) and downscaling, i.e. using only a sample of agents. While the first strategy has been studied in detail in mainstream economics, the implications of the second option – which is mainly used in complexity economics – are underresearched. This paper contributes to filling this gap by proposing a protocol for sensitivity analysis with respect to the scaling choice in these models. We introduce this protocol in a dual manner. First, we identify three main theoretical channels via which scaling can influence complex economic ABMs: (i) idiosyncratic shocks, (ii) information loss due to insufficient interactions, and (iii) the distribution of the characteristics of agents. Second, we analyse the implications of these mechanisms by assessing the trade-offs between three fundamental measures of model performance: precision, accuracy and running time, with different downscaling levels ranging between 0.25%–100% of the full population. We illustrate our approach using the model of Mérő et al. (2023), which is suitable for representing the housing market of Hungary at any scale in this interval (from 10,000 to 4 million agents). We show that in this model there is a non-trivial relationship between the scaling factor and the model performance. Not only does the model’s accuracy and precision depend on the model size in a non-linear manner, we also found that the evaluation of a scenario at a given level of precision takes only three to four times longer with 100 times more agents.
articles.abstract_cn: 在经济学中，通常采用两种策略来减少模型的规模和复杂性：（i）通过聚合实际实体来使用代表性代理，（ii）和缩小规模，即仅使用代理样本。虽然主流经济学已经对第一种策略进行了详细研究，但第二种选择（主要用于复杂性经济学）的影响却尚未得到充分研究。本文通过提出关于这些模型中缩放选择的敏感性分析协议，有助于填补这一空白。我们以双重方式引入该协议。首先，我们确定了规模化影响复杂经济 ABM 的三个主要理论渠道：（i）特殊冲击，（ii）由于相互作用不足而导致的信息丢失，以及（iii）主体特征的分布。其次，我们通过评估模型性能的三个基本指标（精度、准确度和运行时间）之间的权衡来分析这些机制的影响，不同的缩减水平范围在0.25%–100%之间。我们使用 Mérő 等人的模型来说明我们的方法。 （2023），适合代表该区间内任何规模的匈牙利房地产市场（从 10,000 到 4 百万代理商）。我们表明，在这个模型中，比例因子和模型性能之间存在着重要的关系。模型的准确度和精度不仅以非线性方式取决于模型大小，而且我们还发现，在给定精度水平下评估场景只需使用 100 倍的智能体，时间只需三到四倍。

articles.title_en: Project selection with biased advice: An experiment on competitive cheap talk
articles.title_cn: 带有偏颇建议的项目选择：竞争性廉价交谈实验
articles.abstract_en: When agents with private information compete for resources from an uninformed decision-maker and are biased towards their own favored projects (e.g., a CEO decides which division manager’s project to fund), they have incentive to strategically communicate about their project’s value. However, possible future interaction can mitigate this problem even without reputational concerns, since an agent who induces acceptance of a low-valued project today consumes firm resources that crowd out better opportunities that may arrive in the future. We study this organizational environment both theoretically and empirically using laboratory experiments. We hypothesize and find that truth telling is easier to support as low-quality projects lose value or become more likely to occur, but harder to support as agent competition grows. We see an interesting behavioral result in which beliefs influence responsiveness to parameter changes. Specifically, as agents grow more pessimistic about the likelihood of truthful reporting by their competitors, they respond more sharply to parameter changes, in line with the model’s predictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 当拥有私人信息的代理人竞争来自不知情决策者的资源，并且偏向于自己偏好的项目时（例如，CEO决定资助哪个部门经理的项目），他们有动机就自己项目的价值进行策略性沟通。然而，即使没有声誉方面的考虑，未来可能的互动也能缓解这一问题，因为今天诱导接受低价值项目的代理人消耗了公司资源，这些资源挤出了未来可能出现的更好机会。我们通过实验室实验从理论和实证两方面研究这一组织环境。我们假设并发现，当低质量项目价值降低或更可能发生时，诚实告知更容易得到支持，但随着代理人竞争加剧，诚实告知更难得到支持。我们观察到一个有趣的行为结果，即信念影响对参数变化的响应性。具体而言，随着代理人对竞争对手诚实报告的可能性变得更加悲观，他们对参数变化的反应更加剧烈，这与模型的预测一致。

articles.title_en: Social norm uncertainty: Measurement using coordination games and behavioral relevance
articles.title_cn: 社会规范不确定性：基于协调博弈的测量及其行为相关性
articles.abstract_en: We propose a modified pure coordination game to elicit social norm perception as distributions at the individual level. In addition to receiving point estimations equivalent to Krupka and Weber (2013), the dispersion of individual-level norm distributions indicates a subject's social norm uncertainty. In an experiment involving allocation decisions, we measure and gauge the behavioral relevance of norm uncertainty. We find that subjects exhibit considerable uncertainty regarding both injunctive and descriptive social norms. Moreover, social norm uncertainty weakens the relationship between norms as point estimations and revealed social preferences. Finally, the more confident subjects are about their own norm perception, the more they disagree at the population level. The results indicate that uncertainty is a distinct and behaviorally relevant dimension of norm perception that reduces norm compliance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种改进的纯协调博弈，以个体层面的分布形式引出社会规范感知。除了获得与Krupka和Weber（2013）相当的点估计外，个体层面规范分布的离散程度表明受试者的社会规范不确定性。在一项涉及分配决策的实验中，我们测量并评估了规范不确定性的行为相关性。我们发现，受试者在指令性规范和描述性社会规范方面均表现出相当大的不确定性。此外，社会规范不确定性削弱了作为点估计的规范与揭示的社会偏好之间的关系。最后，受试者对自己的规范感知越自信，他们在总体层面的分歧就越大。结果表明，不确定性是规范感知的一个独特且行为相关的维度，它降低了规范遵从性。

articles.title_en: Lengthy waiting corrupts, especially when unexpected
articles.title_cn: 漫长的等待会导致腐败，尤其是在意外的情况下
articles.abstract_en: Results of two studies demonstrate that long and unexpected waits adversely shape moral behavior. In Study 1, passengers who had just joined the check-in line at Ben Gurion Airport guessed how long they would have to wait to check in, and then their actual wait duration was recorded. After checking in, they privately rolled a die, reported an outcome while knowing that higher reports yield higher earnings. We found that wait duration is positively associated with lying. Study 2 (laboratory experiment) exogenized the duration of waits (long versus short) and whether those durations were known (expected) or unknown (unexpected) to subjects in advance. We find that long waits cause, on average, more lying than short waits, and that average lying is the highest for long and unexpected waits. We propose that after long and unexpected waits, people may seek compensation in the monetary domain via relaxed morals.
articles.abstract_cn: 两项研究的结果表明，长期和意外的等待会对道德行为产生不利影响。在研究1中，刚在本古里安机场排队办理登机手续的乘客猜测他们需要等待办理登机手续的时间，然后记录他们的实际等待时间。签到后，他们私下掷骰子，报告结果，同时知道更高的报告会产生更高的收益。我们发现等待时间与说谎呈正相关。研究二（实验室实验）外生了等待的持续时间（长与短）​​以及这些持续时间对于受试者来说是提前已知（预期）还是未知（意外）。我们发现，平均而言，长时间的等待比短暂的等待导致更多的谎言，而长期和意外等待的平均谎言率最高。我们提出，经过漫长而意想不到的等待，人们可以通过放松的道德来寻求货币领域的补偿。

articles.title_cn: 衡量流媒体平台的成功
articles.abstract_en: Digital streaming platforms , including Twitch, Spotify, Netflix, Disney+, and Kindle, have emerged as major sources of entertainment with significant growth potential. Many of these platforms distribute royalties among streamers, artists, producers, or writers based on their impact. In this paper, we measure the relevance of each of these contributors to the overall success of the platform, which can play a key role in revenue allocation. We perform an axiomatic analysis to provide normative foundations for four relevance metrics: the uniform, the subscriber-uniform, the proportional, and the subscriber-proportional indicators. The last two indicators implement the so-called pro-rata and user-centric models, which are extensively applied to distribute revenues in the music streaming market. The axioms we propose formalize different principles of fairness, stability, and non-manipulability, and are tailor-made for the streaming context. We complete our analysis with a case study that measures the influence of the 19 most-followed streamers worldwide on the Twitch platform.
articles.abstract_cn: 数字流媒体平台，包括Twitch、Spotify、Netflix、Disney+和Kindle，已成为具有显著增长潜力的主要娱乐来源。这些平台中的许多根据创作者、艺术家、制作人或作家的影响力向其分配版税。在本文中，我们衡量每位贡献者对平台整体成功的相关性，这可能在收入分配中发挥关键作用。我们进行了公理化分析，为四种相关性指标提供规范性基础：均匀指标、订阅者均匀指标、比例指标和订阅者比例指标。后两种指标实现了所谓的按比例分配和用户中心模型，这些模型被广泛应用于音乐流媒体市场的收入分配。我们提出的公理形式化了公平性、稳定性和不可操纵性的不同原则，并针对流媒体情境量身定制。我们通过一个案例研究完成了分析，该案例衡量了全球关注度最高的19位主播在Twitch平台上的影响力。

articles.title_en: Doing more for less? New evidence on lobbying and government contracts
articles.title_cn: 以更少投入获得更多？关于游说与政府合同的新证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper exploits the unanticipated sequestration of federal budget accounts in March 2013 to examine how contractors adjusted lobbying activities in response to the sequester. The sequestration reduced the funds disbursed through procurement. Firms with limited exposure to these cuts reduced lobbying spending after the event, whereas firms with high exposure maintained, or even increased, lobbying expenses. More affected firms appear to have intensified lobbying efforts to distinguish themselves, and to improve their chances of procuring a larger share of the reduced pie. These effects are stronger for government-dependent sectors and sectors where competition is more intense. Firms that increased lobbying obtained more contracts after sequestration. Overall evidence points towards the existence of a preferential treatment motive of lobbying. At the same time, we cannot rule out that lobbying may also serve an information-revealing purpose.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用2013年三月联邦预算账户的意外扣押，考察承包商如何调整游说活动以应对扣押。扣押减少了通过采购支付的资金。对削减风险敞口有限的企业在事件后减少了游说支出，而高风险敞口的企业则维持甚至增加了游说费用。受影响更大的企业似乎加强了游说努力以使自己脱颖而出，并提高在缩小的蛋糕中获得更大份额的机会。这些效应在政府依赖型部门和竞争更激烈的部门中更为显著。增加游说的企业在扣押后获得了更多合同。总体证据指向游说存在优惠待遇动机。同时，我们不能排除游说也可能服务于信息揭示的目的。

articles.title_en: Fostering environmental integrity via investor-focused communications: Private in-house meeting disclosures and greenwashing behaviors
articles.title_cn: 通过面向投资者的沟通促进环境诚信：私有内部会议披露与漂绿行为
articles.abstract_en: This study explores whether and how mandatory disclosure of private in-house meetings affects corporate environmental behaviors. Employing a difference-in-differences model, we find that regulated firms significantly reduce their greenwashing behaviors in response to the implementation of mandatory disclosure of private in-house meetings. We identify that mandatory disclosure of private in-house meetings decreases greenwashing behaviors by fostering a corporate culture of integrity. Firms with higher information asymmetry before the mandate exhibit a greater reduction in greenwashing behaviors after mandatory disclosure of private in-house meetings. Furthermore, we document that firms reducing greenwashing as a result of this mandatory disclosure policy witness an improvement in their social reputations. Our study offers insightful implications to policymakers and practitioners by shedding light on the significant role of investor-focused communications in mitigating greenwashing behaviors, thereby bolstering firms’ environmental integrity and accountability.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了强制披露私有内部会议是否以及如何影响企业环境行为。采用双重差分模型，我们发现受监管企业在实施强制披露私有内部会议后显著减少了其漂绿行为。我们识别出，强制披露私有内部会议通过培育诚信的企业文化来减少漂绿行为。在强制披露前信息不对称程度较高的企业，在强制披露私有内部会议后漂绿行为减少得更多。此外，我们记录到，因这一强制披露政策而减少漂绿行为的企业，其社会声誉有所提升。我们的研究为政策制定者和从业者提供了有洞察力的启示，揭示了面向投资者的沟通在缓解漂绿行为中的重要作用，从而增强企业的环境诚信和问责性。

articles.title_en: Evaluating the effects of a low-cost, online financial education program
articles.title_cn: 评估低成本在线金融教育项目的效果
articles.abstract_en: We provide evidence on how a low-cost, online, and scalable financial education program influences older participants’ financial knowledge. We test the program using a field experiment that includes short stories covering three fundamental financial education topics: compound interest, risk diversification, and inflation. Two surveys are administered eight months apart to measure the effects of those stories on middle-aged and older (45+) participants' short-term and longer-term knowledge and financial behavior. We show that the risk diversification story is the most effective at improving participants' knowledge, in both the short and longer terms. In the short term, reading the risk diversification story significantly increased the likelihood of correctly answering the related knowledge questions by 17–18 percentage points. The compound interest and inflation stories significantly increase participant knowledge in the short term, but the gain in financial literacy declines over time. Furthermore, timestamp data was used to show that the inflation story increased the time participants spent answering the related knowledge questions suggesting that exposure to our story boosted participants’ attentiveness and interest in the topic. Over just an eight-month time period, the stories do not seem to have a significant effect on financial behaviors as measured by four financial distress indicators and a financial resilience index. Nevertheless, higher financial literacy is positively linked to better financial decision-making. The eight months might be too short to measure significant behavioral change; thus, further research is needed to prove the intervention's effect on financial behavior in the long run.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于一个低成本、在线且可扩展的金融教育项目如何影响老年参与者金融知识的证据。我们通过一项实地实验来测试该项目，该实验包含涵盖三个基本金融教育主题的短篇故事：复利、风险分散和通货膨胀。我们进行了两次相隔八个月的调查，以衡量这些故事对中老年（45岁及以上）参与者短期和长期知识及金融行为的影响。我们发现，风险分散故事在提高参与者知识方面最为有效，无论是在短期还是长期。在短期内，阅读风险分散故事显著提高了正确回答相关知识问题的可能性，提高了17-18个百分点。复利和通货膨胀故事在短期内显著提高了参与者的知识，但金融素养的提升随时间推移而下降。此外，时间戳数据被用来显示通货膨胀故事增加了参与者回答相关知识问题所花费的时间，这表明接触我们的故事提高了参与者对该主题的关注度和兴趣。仅在八个月的时间段内，这些故事似乎对金融行为没有显著影响，这些行为通过四个金融困境指标和一个金融韧性指数来衡量。尽管如此，更高的金融素养与更好的金融决策正相关。八个月可能太短，无法衡量显著的行为变化；因此，需要进一步研究来证明该干预措施对金融行为的长期影响。

articles.title_en: Nature's impact: Do extreme natural disasters influence retail investors?
articles.title_cn: 自然的影响：极端自然灾害是否影响散户投资者？
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the influence of extreme natural disasters on the trading behaviour of retail investors, focusing on two significant events in Australia: Cyclone Debbie in 2017 and the Black Summer bushfires in 2019–2020. Utilising a unique dataset of transaction-level trade data, we examine whether retail investors exhibit a preference for trading stocks with Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) ratings during these periods. The findings reveal that retail investors significantly increase their trading activities in ESG-rated stocks (especially high ratings) in the aftermath of these disasters. This behaviour suggests a heightened awareness and preference for ESG performance among retail investors when faced with catastrophic events. In contrast, institutional investors do not show similar trading patterns, indicating a divergence in investment strategies between retail and institutional investors during times of heightened market uncertainty. Despite awareness concerning ESG during natural disasters, we find that ESG stocks heavily purchased by retail investors generate negative returns in the five-day window subsequent to the natural disasters.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨极端自然灾害对散户投资者交易行为的影响，重点关注澳大利亚的两起重大事件：2017年的黛比气旋和2019-2020年的黑色夏季丛林大火。利用独特的交易级数据数据集，我们考察散户投资者在这些时期是否表现出对具有环境、社会和治理（ESG）评级的股票的交易偏好。研究结果显示，在这些灾害发生后，散户投资者显著增加了对ESG评级股票（尤其是高评级）的交易活动。这种行为表明，在面对灾难性事件时，散户投资者对ESG表现的意识和偏好有所提高。相比之下，机构投资者并未表现出类似的交易模式，表明在市场不确定性加剧时期，散户投资者与机构投资者之间的投资策略存在分歧。尽管在自然灾害期间对ESG有所认识，我们发现散户投资者大量购买的ESG股票在自然灾害后的五天窗口期内产生了负回报。

articles.title_en: Safety accidents and mutual fund flows
articles.title_cn: 安全事故与共同基金流动
articles.abstract_en: Using a hand-collected dataset on major safety accidents (MSAs) in China, we find risky equity funds experience negative net flows following MSAs. Furthermore, riskier funds demonstrate higher sensitivities to casualties than safer funds do. Consistent with the idea that more serious accidents attract greater public attention, “extraordinarily serious” accidents’ impact on flows is larger than “serious” accidents’. Investors’ willingness to take risks decreases and insurance demand increases following MSAs. Flows are not explained by funds’ exposure to MSAs’ economic losses. Collectively, we interpret the negative effect of MSAs on subsequent fund flows as evidence of increased risk aversion stemming from negative emotions associated with MSAs.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用手工收集的中国重大安全事故（MSAs）数据集，我们发现风险较高的股票型基金在MSAs后经历负的净流入。此外，风险更高的基金对伤亡人数的敏感度高于较安全的基金。与更严重的事故吸引更多公众关注的观点一致，“特别重大”事故对资金流动的影响大于“重大”事故。MSAs后投资者的风险承担意愿下降，保险需求增加。资金流动并非由基金对MSAs经济损失的敞口所解释。总体而言，我们将MSAs对后续基金流动的负面影响解释为与MSAs相关的负面情绪导致的风险厌恶增加。

articles.title_en: Religiosity and crime: Evidence from a city-wide shock
articles.title_cn: 宗教信仰与犯罪：来自全市冲击的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the impacts of religiosity on criminal activity using a city-wide shock to religious sentiment from a 2015 Papal visit. Using daily data on all reported offenses between 2010 and 2015 in Philadelphia at the census tract level and a difference-in-differences approach, we demonstrate significant reductions in less serious crimes in the week of the visit and for several weeks following. Reductions are particularly pronounced for drug offenses and in historically Christian areas. Notably, similar crime effects are not found for President Obama’s 2015 visit, suggesting changes in police deployment do not drive results.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用2015年教皇访问对宗教情感产生的全市冲击，估计了宗教信仰对犯罪活动的影响。基于2010年至2015年间费城人口普查区层面的所有报告犯罪的每日数据，并采用双重差分方法，我们发现在访问当周及随后数周内，轻微犯罪显著减少。毒品犯罪和历史基督教区域的减少尤为明显。值得注意的是，奥巴马总统2015年的访问并未产生类似的犯罪效应，这表明警察部署的变化并非驱动结果的因素。

articles.title_en: Boarding education and children's human capital development
articles.title_cn: 寄宿教育与儿童人力资本发展
articles.abstract_en: Boarding schools, offering an alternative residential arrangement to the traditional home environment, have been under-studied regarding their impacts on students’ non-cognitive development. This study presents findings derived from a quasi-experimental design where changes in local educational policy caused a transition from voluntary to compulsory boarding. Results indicate that boarding students outperform their non-boarding counterparts in both cognitive and non-cognitive outcomes, with disadvantaged students exhibiting the largest gains. We attribute these effects to increased teacher engagement in course preparation, closer teacher-student interactions, and heightened student effort toward academic pursuits. These findings underscore the potential of boarding schools as a powerful catalyst for enhancing students’ human capital.
articles.abstract_cn: 寄宿学校提供了一种替代传统家庭环境的居住安排，但其对学生非认知发展的影响研究不足。本研究基于一项准实验设计的结果，该设计中地方教育政策的变化导致了从自愿寄宿向强制寄宿的转变。结果表明，寄宿学生在认知和非认知结果上均优于非寄宿学生，其中处于不利地位的学生获益最大。我们将这些效应归因于教师课程准备投入的增加、师生互动的加强以及学生对学业追求的努力提升。这些发现强调了寄宿学校作为增强学生人力资本的强大催化剂的潜力。
